model_card.name: AML False Positive Suppression Model v2.1
model_card.purpose: Predict whether an AML alert is a genuine SAR candidate (TP) or false positive (FP)
model_card.label_source: Hybrid: STR lookforward window (primary) + Case management disposition (fallback)

label_logic.step_1_str: TP_FROM_STR=1 if STR filed on alert account within 60 days after ALERT_DATE
label_logic.step_3_final: FINAL_LABEL = 1 if TP_FROM_STR==1 else CASE_LABEL (NaN excluded from training)

leakage_prevention.leakage_assertion: Runtime assert confirming no forbidden columns in feature matrix

model_card.split_strategy: Temporal (out-of-time) — train on pre-2024, test on 2024+
key_changes_from_v2: STR dataset incorporated as primary label source via 60-day lookforward window
FINAL_LABEL = STR confirmation OR case disposition (whichever is available and positive)
Pre-alert transaction windowing enforced (TXN_TIMESTAMP < ALERT_DATE per alert)
PRIORITY removed from features (post-alert assignment risk)
Runtime leakage assertion added to feature engineering stage
Model card documents all forbidden features and leakage controls
